# Impact Planner Revision-6 Independent Review Outcome: pass ## Context Identity Recomputed all 29 declared repository context bindings from `C:\tmp\swecircuit-identity-main`; every file matched its declared raw SHA-256 digest and byte count. The eight predecessor handoff files parsed as `SpecialistAgentHandoff` envelopes with required top-level fields and closed evidence entries. The lineage is coherent: revision 5 ended in `fix` because the visual row was 44px high but only the 20px checkbox owned activation; revision 6 records the authorized repair of moving row layout, padding, cursor, and 44px minimum height onto the enclosing label and adding focused source-to-stylesheet regression coverage. The supplied package-verification receipt, authenticated verifier handoff, host browser receipt, and fan-in assessment all bind to revision 6, the expected compilation digest, and an integration-ready dependency handoff. ## Verification `npm.cmd test` passed 23 of 23 tests with zero failures, skips, cancellations, or todos. `npm.cmd run check` passed syntax checks for all seven declared JavaScript files: `server.mjs`, `src/app.js`, `src/codec.js`, `src/graph.js`, `src/storage.js`, `src/ui-policy.js`, and `src/view.js`. ## Product, Accessibility, And Security Review The current candidate renders each changed component as `
    • `, so the label provides the checkbox's accessible name and owns click activation for the text and padding. The stylesheet places `display: flex`, `min-height: 2.75rem`, padding, wrapping, and `cursor: pointer` on `.changed-item label`; `.changed-item` itself has no padding, so the full visible 44px row target belongs to the label rather than a non-interactive wrapper. Focus semantics are preserved: the checkbox remains the real form control, global `input:focus-visible` styling remains active, and the change handler re-renders then focuses the matching `[data-changed-id]` checkbox. Forced-colors support still preserves visible borders for `.changed-item`, and responsive rules plus the host browser receipt show zero horizontal overflow on desktop and mobile. The host browser receipt reports desktop labels at 44px high with padding clicks outside the 20px checkbox toggling the control, and mobile labels at 44px high with zero overflow and no console warnings or errors. This directly addresses the revision-5 failure. Security review found the server limited to declared local routes with CSP `default-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'`, loopback binding, method limits, and no route traversal surface. UI rendering uses DOM APIs and `textContent` for user-controlled values; no `innerHTML`, eval-like sink, network fetch, or external dependency path was found in the declared application files. ## Verdict Pass. Context identity, predecessor lineage, package and fan-in receipts, automated gates, label-owned pointer target behavior, focus preservation, semantics, forced-colors behavior, responsive layout, security posture, and traceability have no material finding.
